cd /exercise && python - <<'EOF'
import json
from rest_api import RestAPI

api = RestAPI({"users": []})
for n in ["Adam", "Bob", "Chuck", "Dan"]:
    api.post("/add", json.dumps({"user": n}))
api.post("/iou", json.dumps({"lender": "Bob",   "borrower": "Adam", "amount": 12.0}))
api.post("/iou", json.dumps({"lender": "Chuck", "borrower": "Adam", "amount": 4.0}))
api.post("/iou", json.dumps({"lender": "Dan",   "borrower": "Adam", "amount": 9.5}))
api.post("/iou", json.dumps({"lender": "Adam",  "borrower": "Bob",  "amount": 6.5}))
api.post("/iou", json.dumps({"lender": "Adam",  "borrower": "Dan",  "amount": 2.75}))

resp = json.loads(api.get("/users", json.dumps({"users": ["Adam"]})))
expected = {"users": [{"name": "Adam",
                       "owes": {"Bob": 5.5, "Chuck": 4.0, "Dan": 6.75},
                       "owed_by": {},
                       "balance": -16.25}]}
assert resp == expected, resp
print("E2E corrected OK:", resp)

allu = json.loads(api.get("/users"))["users"]
assert [u["name"] for u in allu] == ["Adam", "Bob", "Chuck", "Dan"]
for u in allu:
    assert abs(u["balance"] - round(sum(u["owed_by"].values()) - sum(u["owes"].values()), 2)) < 1e-9, u
    assert all(v != 0 for v in u["owes"].values()) and all(v != 0 for v in u["owed_by"].values()), u

# symmetry: A owes X in someone's owes <=> X owed_by A
byname = {u["name"]: u for u in allu}
for u in allu:
    for n, v in u["owes"].items():
        assert byname[n]["owed_by"][u["name"]] == v, (u, n, v)
    for n, v in u["owed_by"].items():
        assert byname[n]["owes"][u["name"]] == v, (u, n, v)
print("Symmetry + balance invariants OK")

# full repayment zeroes out and prunes entries
api2 = RestAPI({"users": [{"name": "A", "owes": {}, "owed_by": {}, "balance": 0.0},
                          {"name": "B", "owes": {}, "owed_by": {}, "balance": 0.0}]})
api2.post("/iou", json.dumps({"lender": "A", "borrower": "B", "amount": 7.25}))
out = json.loads(api2.post("/iou", json.dumps({"lender": "B", "borrower": "A", "amount": 7.25})))
assert out["users"] == [
    {"name": "A", "owes": {}, "owed_by": {}, "balance": 0.0},
    {"name": "B", "owes": {}, "owed_by": {}, "balance": 0.0},
], out
print("Full repayment prunes to empty OK")

# balance always float even when empty, and single-user/no-user cases
assert json.loads(RestAPI({"users": []}).get("/users")) == {"users": []}
single = RestAPI({"users": []})
single.post("/add", json.dumps({"user": "Zed"}))
assert json.loads(single.get("/users")) == {"users": [{"name": "Zed", "owes": {}, "owed_by": {}, "balance": 0.0}]}
assert isinstance(json.loads(single.get("/users"))["users"][0]["balance"], float)
print("Empty/single-user float balance OK")
EOF
